# Labeling Agreement (T3.1.3; generated by `python -m fda_recall.labeling.agreement`)

Two **LLM annotators** (not human): A = Claude Opus 5.5 labeled all 300 events; B = an independent session given only the taxonomy and labeling guide, blind to A's labels, labeled a random 60 (seed 7).

- Cohen's kappa (primary label): **0.981** (target >= 0.75)
- Raw agreement: 98.3% (59/60)
- Gold labels frozen: `data/labels/gold_v1.csv` sha256 `7b9e30128daf0349aa3422d7fdf71823218745e2a634809f1ed877204a045d6a`

Limitations: both annotators are the same model family and share the written guide, so agreement can overstate accuracy (shared systematic errors are invisible). Annotator A also authored the keyword baseline rules. A human spot check is recommended before external use.
